accepted.s: The National Logistics Policy was launched in which year?

accepted.s: The National Logistics Policy 2022 is intended to complement which programme?
accepted.x: The National Logistics Policy complements PM GatiShakti by improving logistics efficiency and coordination.
accepted.tq: Identify the complementary programme associated with the policy.

accepted.s: By 2030, the National Logistics Policy aims to reduce logistics costs to:
accepted.x: The policy aims to reduce logistics costs to single digits of GDP by 2030.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an official target expressed as a range or threshold from an exact figure.
accepted.sec: National Logistics Policy 2022 - cost target, LEADS, ULIP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding logistics costs in India:
1. Logistics costs were estimated at 7.97% of GDP in FY 2024.
2. The corresponding estimate for FY 2023 was 8.84% of GDP.
3. Older estimates placed logistics costs at 13–14% of GDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the FY24 estimate was 7.97%, compared with 8.84% in FY23, while older estimates were 13–14%.
accepted.tq: Test a cluster of numerical statements while using the declining trend as the distinguishing clue.
accepted.sec: National Logistics Policy 2022 - cost target, LEADS, ULIP

accepted.s: What is the full form of ULIP in the context of logistics infrastructure?
accepted.x: ULIP stands for Unified Logistics Interface Platform.
accepted.tq: Test the exact expansion of a commonly confused acronym.
accepted.sec: National Logistics Policy 2022 - cost target, LEADS, ULIP

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the role of LDB 2.0?
o: It monitors inland agricultural warehouses only.
It tracks containers on the high seas.
accepted.x: LDB 2.0 tracks containers on the high seas and is associated with NICDC.
accepted.tq: Match a logistics platform with its specific operational function.
accepted.sec: National Logistics Policy 2022 - cost target, LEADS, ULIP

accepted.s: LEADS was introduced in which year?
accepted.x: LEADS was introduced by DPIIT in 2018.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes LEADS 2025?
o: It has two tiers and covers only inland States.
It has four tiers, with Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Mizoram and Delhi among the exemplars.

It has five tiers and is prepared by NICDC.
accepted.x: LEADS 2025 has four tiers, and the listed exemplars are Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Mizoram and Delhi.
accepted.tq: Combine a classification count with the associated examples rather than relying on one keyword.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh’s port infrastructure:
1. Andhra Pradesh has a coastline of 1,053.07 km.
2. The State has one major port, Visakhapatnam.
3. It has 17 notified non-major ports, including three captive ports.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh has a 1,053.07 km coastline, one major port at Visakhapatnam and 17 notified non-major ports, of which three are captive.
accepted.tq: Combine a numerical fact with port classification and test all components together.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure - ports, Bhogapuram airport, AP Maritime Board

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Machilipatnam is located in Krishna district. Ramayapatnam is in Nellore, Mulapeta is in Srikakulam and Kakinada SEZ port is in Kakinada district.
accepted.tq: Use location discrimination among closely related port projects.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure - ports, Bhogapuram airport, AP Maritime Board

accepted.s: Ramayapatnam greenfield port is being developed through which model, and what is its planned capacity?

accepted.tq: Match the port with its institutional model and capacity.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure - ports, Bhogapuram airport, AP Maritime Board

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Kakinada SEZ port is associated with a cost of ₹4,929 crore in the listed project details? No. The stated cost for Kakinada SEZ port is not provided in the project table; ₹5,156 crore belongs to Machilipatnam.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped cost figure by matching each project with its neighbouring project value.

accepted.s:
With reference to the greenfield ports of Andhra Pradesh, consider the following statements:
1. Mulapeta port follows the landlord model and has a planned capacity of 23.5 MTPA.
2. Machilipatnam port follows the landlord model with MEIL and has a planned capacity of 35 MTPA.
3. Kakinada SEZ port follows the PPP model with GMR and has a planned capacity of 16 MTPA.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the model, associated entity where specified and capacity of the respective ports.
accepted.tq: Verify several rows of a comparison table without reversing model and capacity.

accepted.s:
The Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board is primarily concerned with which of the following functions?
1. Port development
2. Maritime infrastructure
3. Coastal logistics
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board deals with port development, maritime infrastructure and coastal logistics.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Bhogapuram airport is correct?
o: It is being developed by GMR through the PPP-DBFOT model and has a runway of 3,800 metres.
It is being developed by MEIL through an SPV model with a 3,500-metre runway.
It is being developed by the Airports Authority of India through the BOOT model with a 2,800-metre runway.
It is being developed by NICDC through the landlord model with a 3,800-metre runway.
accepted.x: Bhogapuram airport is being developed by GMR through GVIAL under the PPP-DBFOT model, and its runway is 3,800 metres long.
accepted.tq: Use the who-model-specification-location pattern to eliminate swapped authorities and models.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure - ports, Bhogapuram airport, AP Maritime Board

accepted.s: The estimated cost of the Bhogapuram airport project is:
accepted.x: The Bhogapuram airport project has an estimated cost of more than ₹4,700 crore.

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct classification of airports in Andhra Pradesh?
o: One international airport at Visakhapatnam and five regional airports including Bhogapuram
Four international airports including Rajahmundry and three domestic airports including Machilipatnam
Two international airports—Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada—and four domestic airports including Nellore
Three international airports—Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati—and Rajahmundry, Kadapa and Orvakal/Kurnool as the other listed airports
accepted.x: The listed international airports are Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati; the other listed airports are Rajahmundry, Kadapa and Orvakal/Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Test classification by counting and identifying all members of the list.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure - ports, Bhogapuram airport, AP Maritime Board

accepted.s: Orvakal/Kurnool airport is notable because it was:
o: The first international airport of Andhra Pradesh, in 2021
The first airport in India built under the PPP-DBFOT model, in 2022
The first airport built by GMR in coastal Andhra Pradesh, in 2020
The first airport in South India built entirely by a State, in 2021
accepted.x: Orvakal/Kurnool airport was the first airport in South India built entirely by a State, and it was completed in 2021.
accepted.tq: Identify a distinction based on both superlative and year.
